name: ETFR: per-eye gaze offset
description: In the default stereo mode (both eyes in one double-wide layer) converts the eye-tracked foveation centre to an FDM offset in units of one eye's width instead of both eyes', so the full-density region follows the gaze. Use with "ETFR: per-eye density map". True multiview passes are left alone.

sites.name: fdm_offset_centres
sites.evidence: rendersystemvulkan.dll EndRendering 0x34320 (reverse_study 2026-10-16; the only reference to "FDM Offset Info"): after the VR interface call [vtable+110h] (rdx = rbp-80h, four floats: x, y per eye) returns true, 0x34474 (movaps [rsp+110h],xmm6) starts the conversion loop: optional y flip (vr_fdm_offset_flip_y), x * 0.5 * [rdi+1554h] / granularity, y * 0.5 * [rdi+1558h] / granularity, lroundf, times granularity; then vkCmdEndRendering2EXT with VkRenderPassFragmentDensityMapOffsetEndInfoEXT, two offsets. BeginRendering 0x347C0 copies the rendering description (dword 2 = view count, viewMask = (1 << n) - 1 when n > 1) to rdi+1310h and the render area to rdi+154Ch.
